`rustc  -Zvalidate-mir -Zdrop-tracking-mir=yes --edition=2018`
```Rust
#![feature(if_let_guard)]

static mut A: [i32; 5] = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];

async fn fun() {
    unsafe {
        match A {
            _ => (),
            i if let Some(1) = async { Some(1) }.await => (),
            _ => (),
        }
    }
}

fn main() {}
```
